items.note: My call: the batch is refused with a `TypeError` unless every glyph has a string `body` and `group`, an array of `tags`, and a `fill` that is absent or a string. I added this to the 2026-11-11 entry in `docs/unruled.md` (ce8aae7e6c).

items.claim: `useIconGlyph` and `useIconVariant` throw under server rendering because they have no `getServerSnapshot`
A failed variant stays failed after its loader is replaced, so a mounted `useIconVariant` never retries
items.note: A new loader for a failed variant now sets it back to `idle`. The other half of the finding, a new loader for a `loaded` variant being ignored, is not a defect: running it would add the variant's tables a second time. My call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md` (ce8aae7e6c). The variants property test's model was updated to match.
